title: Driver Daily Route Authorization Form
subtitle: Driver Daily Route: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Driver Daily Route Authorization Form controls driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception by tying each Driver Daily Route custody, document, or movement decision to the dispatch / fleet authority, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The route dispatch coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Driver Daily Route Authorization Form at dispatch point, planned route, customer stops, safe parking, and return yard. Check applicable Driver Daily Route requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the dispatch / fleet authority approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception scope.

sections.title: Authorization request and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Driver Daily Route, identify responsible parties, dispatch point, planned route, customer stops, safe parking, and return yard, and the linked driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception source.

fields.label: Stop, order, piece, and time-window references

sections.title: Decision evidence, conditions, and limits
sections.guidance: Capture Driver Daily Route facts for driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Driver Daily Route authorization checks
items: Departure, arrival, service, and departure times
Delivery, pickup, refusal, and failed-attempt result
Delay, reroute, incident, and return reconciliation

sections.title: Decision evidence, expiry, and next control
sections.guidance: Resolve open Driver Daily Route conditions; have route dispatch coordinator assign the next Driver Daily Route owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Hours, weather, road, or fatigue concern
Delay or failed stop lacks accountable routing
Return mileage, pieces, and undelivered inventory
blocks.guidance: Pause Driver Daily Route when driver, vehicle, route safety, cargo custody, or unresolved stop exception prevents controlled continuation. Retain the available Driver Daily Route proof and route unresolved driver, vehicle, stop sequence, shipment, time window, mileage, and route exception scope to route dispatch coordinator.
